sensor-results.evidence: Committed synthetic holdout metrics. README says cross-validation, but training.py implements a stratified 25% holdout. No real-world claim or invented confusion counts.

ehl-workflow.evidence: Implemented workflow grounded in README and repository structure; no numerical model performance asserted.

factory-layout-results.evidence: Method overview and portfolio-reported feasibility improvement from 63% to 81%. No source runs or raw benchmark data accessed.

research-matching-workflow.evidence: Job-method summary grounded in portfolio description. SBERT and TF-IDF claims belong to that description, not to the inspected journal-scraper matcher.py.

journal-workflow.evidence: Code-grounded collection workflow. matcher.py uses difflib.SequenceMatcher and normalized author checks; no SBERT implementation claimed.

thermal-farmland.evidence: Sixteen georeferenced RGB aerial image sections around Karlsruhe with deterministic simulated heat values and thresholded connected regions. The heat is not measured thermal imagery, nor inferred from RGB or DWD station data. Location labels do not imply ownership. Portfolio-reported 20% processing-throughput improvement belongs to the owner-confirmed Fraunhofer IOSB project and is not a benchmark of this illustration. Public weather charts are rendered PNG figures with display summaries; hourly measurement files remain local.
